notes.title: Release Notes 2024.03.04.8
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the Industrial Port[/h1]
The new map is here! The "[b]Industrial Port[/b]" operational area features 80 new missions with more variety than ever. This one's a lot more tech heavy so ready up your engineers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047225/c6f1ee1d3e1efd12a0ff9b7e75aedf465c6d63a1.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Upgrade Cards[/h2]
Over 20 new Upgrade Cards, including these three
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047225/a746313a78edacf94e89aae9be1a242583b20d85.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047225/90ad7076bf44dc78d52bcc65f0f00ec629fddd36.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047225/aad0b243a16cc3b03494a9230f75ab1f197f8273.png[/img]
[h2]Seasonal Ranking[/h2]
Become one of the Top 10 players of a Season to earn additional rewards!
[h2]Life Line for everyone[/h2]
The animated skin is now available for all unit vehicles and can be purchased in a bundle or separately
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047225/68139ed417e7a4984178cfc506745d18fadabafd.gif[/img]
[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] Big changes to the Upgrades UI in the Collection: cards are now separated into "Permanent" and "Equipable" and the filter list has been improved
[*] Rework of the Alert Mode activation UI in the mission briefing[/list]
[h1]Now also available on Mac![/h1]

Detailed release notes can be found in [url=https://discord.gg/ZNTXHrnFur]Discord[/url] and on our [url=https://world-of-emergency.com/]website[/url].

Thank you for providing us with feedback by sending crash dumps via the crash report dialog and writing bug tickets on Discord. If you found new bugs or if your reported bug still exists, feel free to continue using Discord to get in touch with us.

notes.title: Release Notes 2023.11.29.13
notes.notes:
Highlights

[list][*]It's the holiday season! EMERGENCY has been decorated with some festive decorations and we've added a new avatar as well as 9 holiday missions to the mix
[*]Steam achievements are now available: There are 187 new achievements for you to unlock
[*]New Upgrade Card bundles
[*]In-game Newsfeed
[*]New missions added
[*]Singleplayer mission rotation: rescue missions that appeared in the previously played shift will now less likely come up in singleplayer mode to make the player experience more varied
[*]Firefighting Update:[list]
[*]Water Tank: we made changes to the water tanks of the water tender and the ladder truck, reducing the base tank size and adding a total of 8 new upgrade cards to improve water tank size, consumption and refill speed, as well as a new legendary card adding a water tank to the fire truck.
[*]Heat Shield: heat shields have been adjusted to also reduce the fire area and the extinguish training for firefighters now also includes a heat shielding passive ability.
[*]Chaos System: extinguishing fires now reduces more chaos to make up for the increased challenge of the water tank update.
[*]Learn more about how the changes affect your firefighting in the detailed release notes on [url=https://discord.gg/qYKhBkQCjS]Discord[/url] or on our [url=https://world-of-emergency.com/news/2023-12-13/252-rlease_notes_2023_11_29_13?lang=en]website[/url].[/list]
[*]Interface language, voice over language and siren sounds can now be set separately
[*]Fixed issues with quests not counting correctly
[*]Various bug fixes
[*]Various fixes based on received crash dumps via the crash report dialog[/list]

Detailed release notes can be found in [url=https://discord.gg/qYKhBkQCjS]Discord[/url] and on our [url=https://world-of-emergency.com/news/2023-12-13/252-rlease_notes_2023_11_29_13?lang=en]website[/url].

notes.title: Release 2023.09.11.5
notes.notes:
Highlights

[list]
[*]30 new trainee and easy missions
[*]Improved matchmaking through quickplay: You now have a higher chance of finding a multiplayer game and will not be automatically sent into a solo shift anymore. We’ve also added a timer for the estimated matchmaking time.
[*]Balancing adjustments to the XP-curve: Beginner players now need more XP for a level-up so they have more time in lower difficulties to gain experience and earn coins and upgrade cards to be better prepared for higher difficulties.
[*]Player profile improvements: You can now show off your units in a unit showcase and see other players’ profiles. You are also now shown a preview of the next level-up reward.
[*]Fixed bugs regarding left over medical objectives which could not be resolved
[*]Fixed bug regarding an empty operation map
[*]Various fixes based on received crash dumps via the crash report dialog
[/list]
Detailed release notes can be found in [url=https://discord.gg/PjnR37s5NN]Discord[/url] or on our [url=https://world-of-emergency.com/news/2023-09-21/237-release_notes_2023_09_11_5?lang=en]website[/url].

notes.title: Patch 2023.07.31.15
notes.notes:
[list][*]ID 6592: Fixed [unknown] player name display which was introduced in hotfix 2023.07.31.14
[*]ID 6549: Fixed issues with alarm signals
[*]Crash fixes based on received crash dumps sent via the crash report dialog
[/list]
Here are a few tips if EMERGENCY doesn't run or runs instable for you, based on what we saw in received crash dumps:
[list][*]Verify your Steam installation of EMERGENCY: A corrupt installation can cause random crashes
[*]Ensure you meet the minimum hardware requirements listed at the bottom of the EMERGENCY Steam store page
[*]Update your graphics driver: We're using Unreal Engine 5.1 and outdated GPU drivers can cause incompatibilities
[*]Third party software like video capturing or optimization tools might interfere with EMERGENCY, try disabling them
[/list]
Thank you for providing us with feedback by sending crash dumps via the crash report dialog and writing bug tickets on Discord. If you found new bugs or if your reported bug still exists, feel free to continue using Discord to get in touch with us.
